items.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: one instant per operation [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal]; one instant per operation [witness: verification:staff_bootstrap_client_portal].
statements:
All portal-owned event timestamps written by one operation, other than an
  audit record's `occurred_at`, are equal; an expiry it writes is that instant plus its TTL, and source-supplied times keep their supplied values.

items.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-009 [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal]; INV-009 [witness: verification:viewer_access_sqlite_uow_client_portal]; INV-021 [witness: verification:snapshot_import_sqlite_uow_client_portal]; INV-030 [witness: verification:expense_intake_uow_client_portal]; INV-042 [witness: verification:project_tracking_audit_writer_sqlite_uow_client_portal]; INV-043 [witness: verification:photo_management_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-009: at most one active grant per (viewer_id, project_id) and per (service_principal_id, project_id)

INV-021: re-publication with identical (project, estimate_id, estimate_version) and identical fingerprint is an idempotent replay; a different fingerprint for the same identity is an integrity conflict storing nothing

INV-030: one recognized_document_id creates at most one Expense and one ExpenseDocument; equal intake_fingerprint replay returns the existing records, while a different fingerprint is an integrity conflict changing nothing
INV-042: a WorkPayment is idempotent by payment_id and is never a factura or accounting posting; payments total is derived
INV-043: a ProgressPhoto is idempotent by intake_id; the gallery is chronological; visibility changes never alter financial or progress data

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-005 [witness: verification:end_to_end_walkthrough_client_portal]; INV-005, INV-006 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal]; INV-006 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal]; INV-006 [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-005: a revoked grant, credential, viewer, or session blocks the next authorization check immediately, per the revocation cascade table
INV-006: a suspended or disabled staff account and a disabled service principal have no valid sessions or usable credentials
quotes: assert module.authorize_producer_scope(store, actor, PROJECT_ID) is False, (
"authenticate with a revoked credential",
AuthenticationRejected,
assert disabled.status == PrincipalStatus.DISABLED and disabled.disabled_by == ADMIN_ID
"authenticate after the principal was disabled",
"issue a credential for a disabled principal",
verdicts.why: The check detects revoked service credentials and grants and verifies that disabling a service principal prevents authentication and credential issuance. It does not test revoked viewers or sessions, or suspended/disabled staff accounts, so it does not assert all of INV-005 and INV-006.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-029 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal]; INV-029 [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-029: a producer import is authorized for the target project per scope_mode and grants before content validation
quotes: assert module.authorize_producer_scope(store, actor, PROJECT_ID) is True
assert module.authorize_producer_scope(store, actor, OTHER_PROJECT_ID) is False
assert module.authorize_producer_scope(store, actor, ARCHIVED_PROJECT_ID) is False
verdicts.why: The check asserts project authorization decisions for granted-project and all-project scope modes. It performs no producer import or content validation, so it does not assert that authorization happens before content validation.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: read value unchanged [witness: verification:derived_views_uow_client_portal]; read value unchanged [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal].
statements: A value read from a repository is unchanged after any use case that read it.
quotes: assert disabled.name == principal.name and disabled.created_at == principal.created_at
assert store.transaction.repository.mutated is False
verdicts.why: The check verifies preservation of selected principal fields and that one rejection path does not call the repository update method. It does not compare every repository-read value before and after every reading use case, so the general unchanged-value invariant is only weakly covered.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: one instant per operation [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal]; one instant per operation [witness: verification:staff_bootstrap_client_portal].
statements:
All portal-owned event timestamps written by one operation, other than an
  audit record's `occurred_at`, are equal; an expiry it writes is that instant plus its TTL, and source-supplied times keep their supplied values.
quotes: assert _ControlledClock.calls == before + 1, (
assert principal.created_at == CLOCK_NOW and principal.created_at.tzinfo is None
assert issue.credential.created_at == CLOCK_NOW and issue.credential.created_at.tzinfo is None
assert revoked.revoked_at == CLOCK_NOW and revoked.revoked_at.tzinfo is None
assert grant.created_at == CLOCK_NOW and grant.created_at.tzinfo is None
assert disabled.disabled_at == CLOCK_NOW and disabled.disabled_at.tzinfo is None
verdicts.why: Wrapped operations are required to capture the clock once, and several resulting timestamps are checked against that instant. The check does not inspect all timestamps written by each operation, expiry-plus-TTL behavior, or preservation of source-supplied times.

quotes: "second active grant for the same project",
AuthorizationRejected,
raise AssertionError(f"{label}: expected {error.__name__}, the call returned instead")
verdicts.why: The check refuses a second active service-principal grant for the same project, covering the service-principal half of INV-009. It does not test viewer grant uniqueness or any behavior from INV-021, INV-030, INV-042, or INV-043.
